meta.title: Flutter Course: Dart to Real Cross-Platform Apps
meta.description: Flutter course for college students and professionals: Dart, Flutter UI, state management, Firebase and production habits, one codebase for Android and iOS, in 10-12 months.
meta.level: Complete beginner (18+); college students, graduates and working professionals
meta.certification: Certificate from Modern Age Coders, awarded on passing the final exam

program_overview.title: Flutter App Development Masterclass
program_overview.tagline: One codebase, both app stores: Dart and Flutter learned properly, from first widget to production-shaped apps with Firebase.
program_overview.description:
Flutter delivers the honest cross-platform promise: one Dart codebase producing genuinely native-feeling apps on Android and iOS, and it has the production adoption to prove it. This live online masterclass builds it in order: Dart as a real language first, then Flutter the widget way, layouts, navigation and UI that feels native on both platforms, then the layer that separates apps from demos: state management chosen with judgment, architecture that survives features, Firebase for auth and data, offline behavior, testing and release discipline. A finale month ships a capstone app and sits the final exam.

The pace is honest: ten teaching months at two live classes a week plus four to six hours of practice, with two more in hand. Problem sets, monthly mixed reviews, phase exams, and a final exam that decides the certificate with a free retest.
what_makes_this_different: Dart first as a real language: Flutter without Dart depth is widget soup
The widget mental model taught until it clicks: composition all the way down
State management with judgment: the options mapped honestly, one mastered
Production habits: offline behavior, testing and release discipline included
An honest 10-month arc with 2 months in hand
Real assessment: weekly problem sets, monthly mixed reviews, phase exams and a final exam with a free retest

learning_path.phase_1: Dart and Flutter foundations (Months 1-3): the language, then widgets, layouts and navigation
learning_path.phase_2: State and architecture (Months 4-6): state management with judgment and structure that survives
learning_path.phase_3: Production features (Months 7-9): Firebase, offline behavior, testing and release discipline
learning_path.phase_4: The finale (Month 10): the capstone app on both platforms, and the final exam

career_outcomes: Cross-platform capability with real production habits
Dart and Flutter depth, the kind teams can build on
A capstone app running on both platforms with store-grade discipline
Honest next roads: mobile roles, product work, or native depth later

faqs.question: What does this Flutter course cover?
faqs.answer: Dart as a real language first, then Flutter properly: the widget mental model, layouts and navigation that feel native on both platforms, state management chosen with judgment, architecture that survives features, Firebase auth and data, offline behavior, testing and release discipline. A finale month ships a capstone app verified on Android and iOS and sits the final exam.

faqs.question: How long does it take to learn Flutter properly?
faqs.answer: Ten months of teaching at 2 live classes a week plus 4 to 6 hours of practice, with two more months in hand for learners who need them. The three teaching phases build the skill and its real-world application; the finale month ships a capstone and sits the final exam.

faqs.question: How am I assessed? Is the certificate just for attending?
faqs.answer: No. Problem sets follow every class with written feedback, monthly reviews deliberately mix new material with earlier topics, each phase ends with a cumulative exam, and the course ends with a final exam: a practical build plus written questions from the whole syllabus. Passing earns the certificate; falling short earns focused revision and a free retest.

faqs.question: Flutter or React Native?
faqs.answer: Both are honest cross-platform answers. Flutter wins on UI consistency and performance-by-default with one language (Dart); React Native wins for teams already deep in JavaScript. We teach both roads in different courses; this one is the Flutter road, chosen most by builders who want pixel-level control on both platforms.

faqs.question: Do I need a Mac for this course?
faqs.answer: Not for learning: Android covers the entire journey on any computer, and the iOS build step is taught honestly as a release-time requirement (Apple mandates a Mac there). Students shipping to the App Store later use a borrowed, used or cloud Mac at that point, stated upfront rather than discovered late.

faqs.question: What are the fees?
faqs.answer: Group classes are ₹1,499 per month, with 2 live classes a week in batches capped at 10 learners. A mini batch of 3-4 learners is ₹2,999 per month, and personal 1-on-1 classes are ₹4,999 per month. International learners pay a price set for their own country, shown on this page in their local currency.

faqs.answer: Live, always: small groups with a real instructor reading your actual code, never pre-recorded videos.
